issues.issue: Tile builds had longer steps between yields, which means hitches while the mainland streams in, worst on phones. Node, all 88 tiles: p99 step 13.0 ms on base vs 19.4 ms on the branch; steps over 16 ms went 32 -> 96, mostly crossings (p90 6 -> 12 ms) and blocks (p90 12 -> 17 ms). Fix: a yield per road stretch, per crossing phase (poles / ped heads and names / corner things) and per block side. Now p99 is 10.0 ms and 25 steps run over 16 ms, both better than base.

Signal cabinets at the south end of blocks next to the wide streets (half 9) stood on top of the block's own sidewalk things, about 40 overlaps: bins, benches, phone booths, mailboxes, planters, hot-dog carts, pay stations, hydrants, bike racks. Cause: there the block's last avenue slot falls at z1-9.5, the same place as the cabinet. Fix: cabinets go only on corners south of the crossing (the block's north end, where z0+7..13 m is always clear). The overlap checker now shows no new overlaps against base.

The wooden utility poles were 'lamp' props, so a car could knock one over and its wires stayed hanging in the air. The wires had no prop id and were drawn in M.rail, which has no objMask, so erasing a pole left its wires too. Fix: each block's whole line (poles, wires, guy wires) is one 'pole' prop. A car is stopped by it like a wall, and erasing it removes everything. The wires now use M.pole, which carries the prop id. Checked in the browser: rub -> fading -> gone, and the poles and every wire vanish (after_line_before_erase / after_line_erased).

East-end guy wire anchors (26 in the city) sat on the curb ramp where the zebra lands: in the pedestrians' crossing path, with the yellow guard floating about 6 cm above the ramp. Fix: the anchor now goes to the corner point past both ramps (x1-0.45). Confirmed in shots.
Corner bollards at (0.98, 0.36) overlapped the ramps' edges, which start 1 m from the corner, and hung about 10 cm over them (712 collision boxes). Fix: moved to 0.85.

Over the avenue, the span's phone cable (about 5.5 m high, 0.7 m from the curb) ran straight through the far corner's signal pole (0.62 m in from the curb, 5.85 m tall). Fix: only the three top wires cross the avenue.

The 5 grid corners without lights are L-bends where cars never stop (roads.js lightAt is always 'g'), yet they had STOP signs, ALL WAY plates and a painted STOP that the cars drove straight through. Fix: those are removed. The zebras, stop bar and arrows stay, and the street names stand on a post of their own.

On residential blocks, papers and leaves dropped on the grass verge were drawn under the grass plane (2 cm above the walk), and the sidewalk's water and phone covers were hidden under it too. Fix: litter on the verge now lies on top of it, and the covers are placed past the verge.

The tile's road paint (4-7k vertices per tile) was rendered into the sun's shadow map and the wet-street mirror. That is wasted work for flat marks 2 cm above the road. Fix: the paint is its own 'paint' draw with noShadow and noReflect. Valley spot: triangles 2.102M -> 2.004M, draw calls 1098 -> 1079.

Not fixed (known): on the curb ramps, feet float up to 9 cm, because plan.js mainlandHeight is a step at the curb. That file is not owned and the function is hot. Pedestrians cross the 1 m ramp in about a second.
Not fixed: a block built before the first tile draws its sign plates without distance culling, in a separate merged pen. The fix needs a one-line hook in mainland/index.js; the impact is negligible.
Not fixed (rare): erasing one residential line leaves the neighbouring line's cross-avenue span dangling at that end.
Not fixed (cosmetic): dead exports warnPost, tarSnake, CURB_WHITE, plus unused texture cells (xing, school, speed25, bikelane). No console logs or debug leftovers.

notes:
I reviewed all of the aspect's commits (8cdea0c, ae895dd, 321d61b, 697c816) and the diff from 6277529. Only the owned files changed: tiles.js, sidewalks.js, and the new roadkit.js / roadside.js / roadmarks.js. ground.js is untouched, there are no outside edits, and no other gta4 branch touches these files. The trees branch keeps the shadeTree options these files use (lite, away).

Five fixes are committed on gta4/streets (ec1d4e0, ece643d, 26d518a, 3330497, 13b91fd):
- Shorter streaming steps.
- Nothing stands on the curb ramps any more (guy-wire anchors, bollards).
- Signal cabinets no longer sit on the blocks' sidewalk things.
- Each block's power line (poles, wires, guy wires) is one prop: cars cannot knock it over, and erasing it removes all of it, wires included.
- Only the top wires cross the avenue, so no cable runs through a signal pole.
- No STOP signs at the 5 bends where cars never stop.
- Litter sits on the grass verge, not under it.
- The road paint is left out of the shadow map and the mirror.

Content check: all text is English, names come from the plan's existing streets, and there are no brands.

What I could not do:
- Floating feet on ramps (up to 9 cm) needs plan.js, which is not owned.
- Culling of plates in a block built before the first tile needs a one-line hook in mainland/index.js.
- A dangling cross-avenue span after erasing a neighbouring line (rare).
- One more draw per block with curb plates remains; the block's paint cannot be marked noShadow without touching blocks.js.
